en.description:
Flick a coin. A live Bitcoin chart falls out.

Sometimes it's a 5-minute candle. Sometimes a week of gold. Once, mid-Trick-Shot, the Nvidia coin slid into the pocket and revealed NVDA's last hour as a green gradient line — and I forgot I was playing.

Eleven real markets sit on the felt:
• Crypto — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Dogecoin
• Metals — Gold (XAU), Silver (XAG), Copper
• Energy — Crude Oil (WTI)
• Stocks — S&P 500 (SPY), Apple (AAPL), Nvidia (NVDA)

Live prices stream from Binance perpetual futures. Every flick rolls a new chart — random timeframe, random style. The same Bitcoin coin shows you a different chart every time you knock it.

The coins have mass that matches the asset. Gold is a brick. Doge is a marble. Hit Copper with Silver and physics behaves like physics. Tilt your phone and the table tilts with you. The felt remembers.

How it plays

• Pass-and-play with a friend, or take on the bot
• Wager Tiny, Big, or All before each shot — pot scales 1× to 5× as coins fall
• 20 hand-designed Trick Shot puzzles, three-star scoring
• Daily Challenge with a par score I have personally failed to beat on a Tuesday

Not a trading app. A fidget toy that happens to stream perpetual futures — bitcoin charts, oil prices, gold price, stock charts of NVDA, AAPL, SPY. All real. All live.

Free. No ads. No subscriptions.

POCKET RACING
Pick one of five original cars and race three laps on the felt circuit. Boost on straights, grip through bends, and coast to recharge. Follow the standings and replay the same challenge with new choices. Racing works offline. Your coin game, daily challenges and trick shots are still here.

versionHistory.releaseNotes: Adds the Apple Watch companion app for quick Flickpot play from your wrist.

2.0 IS A COMPLETE REFRAME — THE COINS ARE MARKETS NOW.

• 11 LIVE FUTURES on the board: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Doge, GOLD, SILVER, COPPER, CRUDE OIL (WTI), S&P 500, APPLE, NVIDIA
• REVEAL CHARTS on every flick — random timeframe (5m, 1h, 1d, 1w) and random style (line or candlesticks). Real Binance fapi data.
• MASS = REALITY: each coin's weight mirrors its real-world heft. Gold heaviest, Doge lightest.
• POT ESCALATION: wagers scale with coins remaining — 1× early, 5× when only two are left. Late-game pressure rises.
• Coin layout spread, sharper visuals, faster physics.
• No accounts, no real money, no ads. Public market data only.
Cleaner description. Same eleven markets, same flick, same coins falling. Bug fixes and minor polish under the hood.

Flicks you can feel. This update is all about game feel:

• Haptics everywhere — draw a shot like a bowstring, feel every coin clack
• New sound design: collision ticks, capture thocks, a proper win fanfare
• Slow-motion drama when a coin teeters on the rim
• COMBO payouts — each extra coin in one flick is worth more (1x, 3x, 6x, 10x)
• Hit-stop, camera shake and color rings on every capture
• The bot actually aims now — it hunts knockout lines instead of guessing
